findings.summary: GetConsoleMode on stdin proves a console handle, not human presence; a ConPTY host (including agent terminal tools) can pass it and type the answers, so the G2 residual is understated; the detached helper has no console or handle to the supervisor's stdin, so 'checked through the helper' cannot run as written

console record lacks fields checkAttestation reads (source, date, uncertainty, operator_ref) and is stamped owner_undertaking_console while v4 requires owner_affirmation; new channels have no adapter-hash stamp rows; fails closed
start_outcome observed_at_ms filled from the launch part, so the 90 s outer deadline and SQL-after-ownership ordering bind to launch time, not the later pidfile/chain observation
revalidation.sql_instance_unchanged has no measuring source (helper revalidate does no SQL; client ended per G7), so it would be a stamped assertion
sql_deadline event has no part schema; refused as PARTS_SCHEMA_MISMATCH, leaving the run without its sql_unknown terminal state
Uint8Array.prototype.slice uses TypedArraySpeciesCreate, so a caller-set constructor/@@species can return a view on a buffer it keeps; use a toStringTag brand check and new Uint8Array(bytes)
'a supervisor time can only make a check stricter' is overclaimed: admitted_at_ms and start_intent at_ms bound helper times in one direction; helper-measured freshness bounds limit the effect

informational: J8 frame type has no carrier in the {channel, bytes} key set; a non-0x02 reply to unprotect must be a protocol error and never forwarded
J9 orphan detection needs durable evidence-directory and history writes before launch; orphan record is new, not a mutation; owner decision carries the J1 caveat
